description:
0.90.0: the folders offered to you by the owners of workspaces you are not a member of (`offered`, each with
        `content`: the text you would be signing) and the folders you were given (`given`). Take an offer with
        accept_folder. A folder given to you is read with list_files / read_file (and write_file, when given to
        write) on its workspace id, under its folder.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token
